description: This module sends HTML formatted notifications to matrix rooms.

parameters.name: hs_url
parameters.description: URL of the homeserver, where the CS-API is reachable.

parameters.name: msg_html
parameters.description: HTML form of the message to send to matrix.

parameters.name: msg_plain
parameters.description: Plain text form of the message to send to matrix, usually markdown.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password to log in with.

parameters.name: room_id
parameters.description: ID of the room to send the notification to.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Authentication token for the API call. If provided, user_id and password are not required.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The user ID of the user.

examples: - name: Send matrix notification with token community.general.matrix: msg_plain: "**hello world**" msg_html: "hello world" room_id: "!12345678:server.tld" hs_url: "https://matrix.org" token: "{{ matrix_auth_token }}" - name: Send matrix notification with user_id and password community.general.matrix: msg_plain: "**hello world**" msg_html: "hello world" room_id: "!12345678:server.tld" hs_url: "https://matrix.org" user_id: "ansible_notification_bot" password: "{{ matrix_auth_password }}"
